Actual leitourgika is NOMINATIVE NEUTER PLURAL ministry/service ADJECTIVE, rendered ministering; it is not a written present ministering participle or a minister-person noun.

Actual diakonian is ACCUSATIVE FEMININE SINGULAR service/ministry NOUN after the genuine purpose eis5. English verbalizes that same service function as serve within to-serve; actual noun/case retained and no diakoneō verb is invented.
Actual apostellomena has functional PRESENT PASSIVE/formal PRESENT MIDDLE-PASSIVE NOMINATIVE NEUTER PLURAL PARTICIPLE analyses, rendered sent rather than a finite/aorist source retag.
Actual accusative masculine plural article personalizes the prospective inheritors and owns those-who without printed demonstrative/relative pronouns.
Actual mellontas is PRESENT ACTIVE ACCUSATIVE MASCULINE PLURAL prospective PARTICIPLE, rendered will without a source future auxiliary retag.
Actual klēronomein is PRESENT ACTIVE inheriting INFINITIVE, rendered inherit with its true lexical head.

unmappedSource.reason: Actual pantes is NOMINATIVE MASCULINE PLURAL all ADJECTIVE used personally. BSB names the contextually identified group as the-angels without an independently expressed universal all; the actual quantifier is not replaced by an angel noun.

Actual dia gives the benefiting-party relation with the prospective inheritors. BSB recasts the service-purpose phrase with those people as the direct English serving object, leaving this separately printed for-the-sake-of relation implicit.

unmappedTarget.reason: English supplies the explicit group designation at this question. Actual N/TR has pantes/all and ministering-spirits without a local angel noun; no prior angel occurrence is silently borrowed.
